text:
Let us go toward the trees… sleep

will come into us by celestial grace.

Let us go toward the trees; the night

will be tender to us, sorrow light.


Let us go toward the trees, the soul

drowsing on the wildwood scent.

But hush, do not speak, be merciful;

do not wake the sleeping birds.

translation.title: Peace
translation.editorial_note: The invitation moves from human grief into woodland quiet; virtue becomes grace to preserve its spiritual agency.
